```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Nat

/-- Auxiliary lemma: solving the Diophantine equation
    `(m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = 5 * p * q` with `p q` primes. -/
private lemma factor_eq (p q m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (hm : p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2) :
    (p = q) ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3) := by
  have hpos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  have hposq : 0 < q := hq.pos
  have hposm : 0 < m := by
    have : 0 < p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 := by
      apply Nat.succ_pos
    have : 0 < m ^ 2 := by
      simpa [hm] using this
    exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left this (Nat.succ_pos _)
  -- rewrite the equation as a product
  have hprod : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = 5 * p * q := by
    have : m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 = 5 * p * q := by
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 = p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q + q ^ 2 := by
        ring
      have : m ^ 2 - (p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q + q ^ 2) = 5 * p * q := by
        simpa [hm, this, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
          mul_assoc, two_mul] using congrArg (fun t => t - (p ^ 2 + 2 * p * q + q ^ 2)) hm
      simpa [sub_eq, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
        mul_assoc] using this
    have hsub : m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 = (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) := by
      simpa [pow_two, sub_mul, mul_sub, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc,
        mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
        (Nat.sub_mul (m) (p + q) (m + (p + q))).symm
    simpa [hsub] using this
  have hposa : 0 < m - (p + q) := by
    have : (p + q) ^ 2 < m ^ 2 := by
      have : p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2 := hm
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q = m ^ 2 := by
        simpa [pow_two, mul_add, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc,
          mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, two_mul] using hm
      have : (p + q) ^ 2 < (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q := by
        apply lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_lt_one) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _))) (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
        exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
      exact lt_of_lt_of_eq this (by symm; exact this)
    have : (p + q) < m := Nat.lt_of_pow_lt_pow this (Nat.succ_pos _)
    exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt this

  set b := m + (p + q) with hb
  have hab : a * b = 5 * p * q := by
    simpa [ha, hb] using hprod
  have hdiff : b - a = 2 * (p + q) := by
    have : b - a = (m + (p + q)) - (m - (p + q)) := by
      simpa [ha, hb] using rfl
    simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc, sub_eq, sub_self, add_sub_cancel] using this

  have hcases : a = 1 ∨ a = 5 ∨ a = p ∨ a = q ∨ a = 5 * p ∨ a = 5 * q ∨ a = p * q ∨ a = 5 * p * q := by
    have : a ≤ 5 * p * q := Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (by
      have : 0 < a * b := Nat.mul_pos hposa hposb
      exact this) (Nat.succ_pos _)) hdiv

      have : a * b = 5 * p * q := hab
      have : a * b < (a + 1) * (b + 1) := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Nat.succ_pos _) hposa
      simpa [hab] using this) (Nat.succ_pos _)) with hle

      have : a ≤ 5 * p * q := this

      simpa [h1] using hab.symm
    have : (b - a) = 5 * p * q - 1 := by simpa [h1] using rfl
    have : 2 * (p + q) = 5 * p * q - 1 := by

    (p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) := by

  · intro h
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime
import Mathlib.Tactic
open Nat

/-- Main theorem: characterisation of primes `p q` such that `p^2 + 7 p q + q^2` is a square. -/
theorem rmo_2001_2 (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) :
    (∃ m : ℕ, p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = m ^ 2) ↔
      (p = q ∨ (p = 3 ∧ q = 11) ∨ (p = 11 ∧ q = 3)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨m, hm⟩
    have h₁ : (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q = m ^ 2 := by
      have : p ^ 2 + 7 * p * q + q ^ 2 = (p + q) ^ 2 + 5 * p * q := by ring
      simpa [this] using hm
    set a := m - (p + q) with ha
    set b := m + (p + q) with hb
    have hab : a * b = 5 * p * q := by
      have : m ^ 2 - (p + q) ^ 2 = 5 * p * q := by
        have := h₁
        linarith
      have : (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) = 5 * p * q := by
        simpa [pow_two, mul_add, add_mul, sub_mul, mul_sub, add_comm, add_left_comm,
          add_assoc, sub_eq, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using this
      simpa [ha, hb] using this
    have hpos : 0 < a := by
      have : 0 < a * b := by
        have : (5 * p * q) ≠ 0 := by
          have hp' : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
          have hq' : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne_zero
          have : (5 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by decide
          exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero this hp'.symm) hq'.symm
        have : a * b = 5 * p * q := hab
        have : a * b ≠ 0 := by
          intro hzero
          have : 5 * p * q = 0 := by simpa [hab] using hzero
          exact this.elim (by decide)
        exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (by
          have : 0 < a * b := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by
            intro hzero; exact this (by simpa [hzero] using rfl))
          exact this)
      exact Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left this
    have hodd : a % 2 = 1 := by
      have : (b - a) % 2 = 0 := by
        have : b - a = 2 * (p + q) := by
          dsimp [a, b] at *
          ring
        simpa [this, Nat.mod_mul_left_mod] using rfl
      have hb : b % 2 = a % 2 := by
        have : (b - a) % 2 = (b % 2 - a % 2) % 2 := Nat.mod_sub_mod _ _ _
        simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod] using this
      have : a % 2 = (a % 2 + 0) % 2 := by
        simpa using rfl
      have : a % 2 = 1 := by
        have : a % 2 = (a % 2 + (b - a) % 2) % 2 := by
          simpa [hb] using rfl
        have : a % 2 = (a % 2 + 0) % 2 := by simpa using rfl
        have : a % 2 = 1 := by decide
        exact this
      exact this
    have hdiv : a ∈ ({1, 5, p, q, p * q} : Finset ℕ) := by
      have hda : a ∣ 5 * p * q := ⟨b, hab.symm⟩
      have h5 : Nat.Prime 5 := by norm_num
      have hcases : a = 1 ∨ a = 5 ∨ a = p ∨ a = q ∨ a = p * q := by
        rcases hp.eq_two_or_odd with rfl | hpodd
        · have : a = 1 ∨ a = 5 ∨ a = q ∨ a = p ∨ a = p * q := by
            have : a ∣ 5 * q := by
              simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hda
            have h5' : a = 1 ∨ a = 5 := by
              have : a ∣ 5 := Nat.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _) this
              rcases Nat.dvd_prime (by norm_num) this with h | h
              · left; exact h
              · right; exact h
            rcases h5' with h1 | h5
            · left; exact h1
            · right; 
              have : a ∣ q := by
```
